Subject: Clarion RFP bake-off — request for stipend structure and escrow option

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking Clarion's RFP. We have shortlisted Redwood and two other vendors for a controlled bake-off next month. Procurement is asking for written confirmation of any evaluation stipend / trial credits you can commit to and whether Redwood can put funds into an escrow (we want neutral oversight) to be released after completion or conversion.

Key asks from our side:
- Pilot stipend size for a 4-week benchmark per team (we plan to run three engineering teams concurrently)
- Whether stipends can be split: partial pre-funded (to kick off tests) + remainder contingent on completion and basic quality gates
- Escrow/legal vehicle for holding the contingent amount (DocuSign or third-party escrow acceptable)
- Any restrictions (time windows, rate limits, model variants excluded)

I attached the RFP and an early SOW draft. We expect to finalize vendor economics by 4/18. Can Redwood provide a short written proposal + internal approval path?

Thanks,

Irene — thanks for the ping. Quick proposal from my side that we can present to Clarion: 

Proposal (internal draft):
- Stipend total: $45k (covers 3 teams x 4 weeks; aligns with other healthcare bake-offs we've done)
- Split: $20k pre-funded at kickoff (non-refundable credit usable only for Clarion RFP workloads), $25k contingent held in escrow and released upon completion if (a) tests ran to completion and (b) minimal quality thresholds met (synthetic pass/fail checks defined in SOW)
- Escrow mechanism: Redwood signs an escrow agreement and funds the contingent portion to a third-party escrow (or we can provide a DocuSign powerform link for immediate acceptance). Finance prefers third-party escrow for amounts > $20k but will accept an internal 'commitment' for strategic deals with legal review.
- Restrictions: credits expire 90 days after release, rate limits to protect shared infra (we'll supply a token-level rate cap), no access to experimental quantization builds without additional signoff.

Need approvals: 
- Sales Ops sign-off on $45k stipend and escrow flow
- Finance/legal ok for third-party escrow or DocuSign-based release language

If Ops confirms, I'll draft the external email and the simple escrow term sheet. Ben

Ben Carter
Principal Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarion stipend proposal — ops/finance sign-off

Ben / Irene — ops + finance reviewed the draft and we can approve this structure with two conditions: 

1) Escrow path: use the third-party escrow vendor listed in our policy for amounts > $20k. Ops will onboard Clarion on KYC/timeframes. We will not pre-fund escrow until legal has signed the standard escrow schedule.
2) Contingent release triggers: keep them narrow — (i) Clarion confirms run completion (email + run IDs), (ii) no critical security incidents, (iii) usage within agreed scope. Finance also wants a one-way conversion credit: if Clarion converts to a Dedicated or Annual committed contract within 90 days, we can apply up to 50% of the contingent stipend toward first-month committed usage (applied as invoice credit).

Deliverables from me by 4/8: standard escrow term sheet, rate-cap template, and a short amendment for the SOW that captures the conversion credit language. Once legal signs, we'll share DocuSign powerform for the initial agreement and escrow KYC.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Liam — appreciate the RFP; below is the summary offer we can execute quickly if it fits your procurement needs.

Summary offer:
- Total evaluation stipend: $45,000 (three concurrent teams, 4-week window)
- Split: $20,000 available immediately as prepaid credits; $25,000 placed into a neutral third-party escrow and released on conditional acceptance
- Escrow & triggers: escrow agent will release contingent funds after Clarion confirms completion via run IDs and a short acceptance email, provided there are no unresolved critical security issues.
- Conversion incentive: up to 50% of the contingent stipend (i.e., $12,500) can be applied as an invoice credit toward a Dedicated/Annual committed contract if Clarion signs within 90 days of escrow release.
- Operational guardrails: credits expire 90 days after release, token-level rate caps will be applied during the benchmark to protect QoS. No experimental quant builds without separate agreement.

Next steps if you want to proceed:
1) Marissa will send the escrow term sheet + SOW amendment for legal review (DocuSign link).
2) Clarion executes the SOW amendment and escrow KYC; we pre-fund the $20k as usage credits.
3) Run kickoff and benchmark execution.

If that structure works, I'll route the term sheet through legal and ops; Marissa will follow up with DocuSign.

Best,
